meta.description: SafeTrade: an execution assistant for Deriv. Trading involves a risk of capital loss.

demo.title: Base components
demo.subtitle: Step 1.2 demo page, to check in light and dark themes.
demo.stopLossError: Stop loss must be between 10 and 100%.
demo.body: Body text, 14 px. Hierarchy comes from size, spacing and colour, never from a weight above 500.
demo.small: Small text, hints and timestamps, 12 px.

auth.panelTitle: Disciplined execution, with limits nothing can bypass.
auth.panelPoint1: Risk limits enforced on the server, never bypassable
auth.panelPoint2: Continuous analysis of Deriv markets, demo first
auth.panelPoint3: Your funds stay at Deriv: SafeTrade never touches them
auth.riskNote: Trading involves a risk of capital loss. No profit is guaranteed.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: Three-day trial on a demo account, no payment method needed.
register.consent: By creating an account, you acknowledge that trading involves a risk of capital loss.
register.successBody: If the address {email} can be used, a confirmation link has just been sent to it. It expires in 24 hours.

verify.title: Confirm your address
verify.body: Confirm your email address to activate your SafeTrade account.
verify.successBody: Your account is active. You can now sign in.
verify.missingBody: This link has no confirmation code. Open the link you received by email.

errors.auth_email_not_verified: Please confirm your email address using the link you received.
errors.auth_account_suspended: This account is suspended. Contact support.
errors.auth_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
errors.auth_password_too_short: The password must be at least 10 characters long.
errors.auth_password_too_long: The password must not exceed 128 characters.
errors.auth_password_too_weak: This password is too simple. Use more varied characters.
errors.auth_verification_invalid: This confirmation link is invalid, already used or expired.
errors.auth_origin_forbidden: Request refused for security reasons. Reload the page.
errors.auth_not_authenticated: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.network_unavailable: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
